theses.subject: Big Banks

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Second-ranked theme with positive momentum, eligible, and not crowded. The trend gate supports participation. However, zero breadth warns of narrow leadership, raising single-stock fragility.
theses.dissent: Zero breadth means the move is driven by a handful of names; any reversal in those could erase gains quickly, and the moderate durability bar offers little cushion.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO total return underperforms the S&P/TSX by 3% before 2026-08-20.

theses.dissent: Falling interest rates or a defensive rotation could spark a rapid recovery in REITs, reversing the negative momentum pattern.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO total return outperforms the S&P/TSX by 3% before 2026-08-20.
